sponsored.t: Relates to making a city school district in N.Y. City eligible for transitional aid for charter school payments
sponsored.sum: Relates to making a city school district in a city having a population of one million or more eligible for transitional aid for charter school payments.

sponsored.t: Establishes an indirect source review for certain warehouse operations
sponsored.sum: Establishes an indirect source review for heavy distribution warehouse operations; requires the department of environmental conservation to conduct a study regarding zero-emissions zones.

sponsored.t: Requires third-party food delivery services and third-party grocery delivery services to provide the ability to include a gratuity at the same point in the online order process when the underlying order is placed
sponsored.sum: Requires third-party food delivery services and third-party grocery delivery services to provide the ability to include a gratuity at the same point in the online order process when the underlying order is placed; provides that customers shall not be required to pay a gratuity; provides that third-party food delivery services and third-party grocery delivery services shall not reduce the compensation of any worker as a result of gratuities; establishes penalties for violations of such provisions.

sponsored.t: Establishes a SNAP and cash assistance fraud victims compensation fund
sponsored.sum: Establishes a SNAP and cash assistance fraud victims compensation fund.

sponsored.t: Repeals section 3 of article 16 relating to the taxation of moneys, credits, securities and other intangible personal property in the state that is not employed in carrying on any business therein
sponsored.sum: Relates to the taxation of moneys, credits, securities and other intangible personal property in the state that is not employed in carrying on any business therein.

sponsored.t: Changes the designation of the public holiday of Columbus day to Indigenous People's Day
sponsored.sum: Changes the designation of the public holiday of Columbus day to Indigenous People's day.

sponsored.t: Establishes the "tenant opportunity to purchase act"
sponsored.ls: Real Property Actions and Proceedings Law
sponsored.sum: Establishes the "tenant opportunity to purchase act"; prevents the displacement of lower-income tenants in New York and preserves affordable housing by providing an opportunity for tenants to own or remain renters in the properties in which they reside.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the use of robots by police agencies
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the use of weaponized robots, non-weaponized robots which may potentially cause injury, or robots being used for surveillance purposes by police agencies.

sponsored.t: Limits the amount of time to submit supporting documentation for major capital improvements
sponsored.sum: Limits the amount of time to submit supporting documentation for major capital improvements; sets such time at one hundred and twenty days.

sponsored.t: Replaces instances of the words or variations of the words American Indian with the words Indigenous peoples or a variation thereof
sponsored.sum: Replaces instances of the words or variations of the words American Indian with the words Indigenous peoples or a variation thereof.

sponsored.t: Relates to increasing the bonding authority of the New York city housing development corporation
sponsored.sum: Increases the bonding authority of the New York city housing development corporation from nineteen billion dollars to twenty billion dollars.
